page.overview:
What is Black Dye?

Black dye is a primary color dye similar to an ink sac.

Wandering traders have a chance to trade 3 black dyes for 1 emerald.

Apprentice-level Shepherd villagers have a 20% or chance to buy 12 black dye for an emerald.
